_about: Provenance protocol cases for ADR-0009. Valid examples are followed by one violation per invariant. All notes are synthetic. JSON prevents test material from entering the indexed Markdown corpus.
_shape: Each case contains frontmatter as text, exercising the parser rather than a pre-parsed dictionary. parent_kind models the provenance of a parent note.
